basic_details.job_title: KAU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Register for Job Alerts The official notification does not mention any application fee.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: Bachelor's degree from the concerned Faculty recognised by Kerala Agricultural University. Master's Degree in the relevant subject recognised by the Kerala Agricultural University with a minimum of 55% marks in the traditional system or its equivalent. Qualifying in the National Eligibility Test conducted by the ICAR/UGC/CSIR/AICTE or similar test accredited by the UGC.

qualification.details: A relaxation of 5% shall be allowed at the master's level for the Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/ Differently-abled (Physically and visually differently-abled) categories for the purpose of eligibility and for assessing good academic record during direct recruitment to teaching positions, based on only the qualifying marks without including any grace mark procedures. Desirable qualifications include knowledge in Malayalam language to read and write, and a Ph.D. in the relevant subject recognised by Kerala Agricultural University.

salary_details.pay_scale: Consolidated pay of Rs. 44,100/- per month

how_to_apply: Access the notification available on the website www.kau.in/coapad.kau.in.
Fill all the fields in the Google Form link provided along with the notification.
There is no need to send hard copy of the application or any other document.
Prepare a filled-in application form in the attached MS word format, with self-attested copies of proof for age, caste, qualification and experience.
Attend the written test/interview on 05.11.2026, 09.30 AM at the College of Agriculture, Padannakkad, along with original certificates for verification.
important_instructions: The candidates for the post of Assistant Professor shall not be over 50 years as on 01.01.2026. The age limit is relaxable in the case of Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and Other Backward Communities as prescribed in the Kerala State and Subordinate Services Rule 1958 as amended from time to time. Interested candidates who applied online are requested to appear for written test/interview as per the schedule with filled-in application (in attached word format), containing self attested copies of proof for age, caste, qualification and experience. Original certificates should be produced for verification. No separate call letter will be sent to the applicants. For further information contact:- Office (9188256616; 0467- 2282699, 2280616).

content_sections.heading: About KAU Assistant Professor (Contract)
content_sections.text: Kerala Agricultural University operates the College of Agriculture at Padannakkad, located in Kasaragod District alongside NH 66 between Nileshwar and Kanhangad. The institution conducts direct recruitment for temporary teaching positions to fulfill academic requirements in agricultural disciplines.

content_sections.text: A relaxation of 5% shall be allowed at the master's level for the Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/ Differently-abled (Physically and visually differently-abled) categories for the purpose of eligibility and for assessing good academic record during direct recruitment to teaching positions, based on only the qualifying marks without including any grace mark procedures. content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated pay of Rs. 44,100/- per month. The appointment is made on a contract basis for the Department of Agronomy at the College of Agriculture, Padannakkad.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KAU Assistant Professor (Contract)
content_sections.text: Access the notification available on the website www.kau.in/coapad.kau.in. Fill all the fields in the Google Form link provided along with the notification. Submit on or before 02.11.2026, 4.00pm. There is no need to send hard copy of the application or any other document. Prepare a filled-in application form in the attached MS word format, with self-attested copies of proof for age, caste, qualification and experience. Attend the written test/interview on 05.11.2026, 09.30 AM at the College of Agriculture, Padannakkad, along with original certificates for verification.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Duly filled-in application form in the attached MS word format, with self-attested copies of certificates & mark lists and a passport size photograph Aadhar Card of the candidate Certificate to prove date of birth SSLC/Equivalent Degree certificate Degree mark list Post graduate degree certificate Post graduate degree mark list Certificate of NET Certificates of additional qualifications such as PhD etc Certificate of experience in related field, if any Scientific publications, other trainings & certifications in the field, if any

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply online for KAU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online Google Form is 02.11.2026, 4.00pm.

faq.question: Q2. When is the interview scheduled for KAU Assistant Professor (Contract)?
faq.answer: The written test/interview is scheduled for 05.11.2026, 09.30 AM.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the Assistant Professor (Contract) post in Agronomy.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary provided for KAU Assistant Professor (Contract)?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated pay of Rs. 44,100/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The candidates for the post of Assistant Professor shall not be over 50 years as on 01.01.2026, with age limit relaxable in the case of Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and Other Backward Communities as prescribed in the Kerala State and Subordinate Services Rule 1958 as amended from time to time.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualifications are required to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree from the concerned Faculty recognised by Kerala Agricultural University, a Master's Degree in the relevant subject recognised by the Kerala Agricultural University with a minimum of 55% marks in the traditional system or its equivalent, and must have qualified in the National Eligibility Test conducted by the ICAR/UGC/CSIR/AICTE or similar test accredited by the UGC.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the interview take place?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the College of Agriculture, Padannakkad, located in Kasaragod District alongside NH 66 between Nileshwar and Kanhangad.
